Remember these simple tricks:

Clouds over Trees: White (RA) above Green (RL).

Coal over Fire: Black (LA) above Red (LL).

Chocolate Near My Heart: Brown (V1) at the 4th intercostal space, right sternal border.

These memory tricks use the AHA colour system. Always follow your facility’s electrode placement guidelines.

niche.description:
Can you name the 5 parts of the brachial plexus? One silly sentence: Randy Travis Drinks Cold Beer.

Roots (5, C5–T1) → Trunks (3: upper, middle, lower) → Divisions (6: front + back) → Cords (3: lateral, posterior, medial, named around the axillary artery) → Branches (5: musculocutaneous, axillary, radial, median, ulnar). Numbers: 5-3-6-3-5.

Quick test: which cord gives the radial nerve? Answer in the video.
